'''Thadus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imperial soldier]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]], he was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], where he ferried messages for [[Darth Lachris]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Sir! Sergeant Thadus, here for Cipher Nine.|Thadus|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
Thadus appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a messenger who starts the final world-arc missions on the Imperial version of Balmorra. He only identifies himself in dialogue to Imperial Agents, and is named simply "Imperial Messenger" as an NPC.
